messages:
lina (customer): Hi team — I just tried to pay invoice INV-2025-091 and the card got declined. Tried a different card and the bank kicked back a 3DS prompt that never displayed, payment failed. Not sure what to do, customer on the line.

jordan (support): Sorry about that, we'll take a look. Can you share the invoice id (you included INV-2025-091) and last4 of the card that failed? Also any error string from the UI?

lina (customer): last4 4242, UI showed 'Payment failed' only. Customer says they saw a gray spinner when the bank should've shown a 3DS challenge and then it timed out.

jordan (support): Thanks. Can you confirm whether this was trying to pay via the hosted pay link or an embedded iframe in your app?

lina (customer): Hosted pay link from the invoice.

payments-bot: payment_intent pi_1JqXy2... failed -> status: requires_action, last_payment_error: {code: authentication_required, message: "3D Secure authentication required"}

kai (payments): This looks like a classic SCA/3DS flow where the PaymentIntent requires customer action. Two likely causes: 1) the bank's 3DS page blocked in the browser (CSP / X-Frame-Options) or 2) the redirect didn't open/pop up so action timed out.

jordan (support): Quick triage steps for the billing team: 
- Check Stripe/PSP dashboard for PI id above: status = requires_action, next_action.redirect_to_url.url present.
- Ask customer to try the hosted link in a different browser or incognito (extensions can block popups).
- If they are on Safari iOS, confirm whether third-party cookies/blocking is enabled.

lina (customer): Customer tried Chrome on Windows and Safari on iPhone, both failed. They also reported a browser console error: "Refused to display 'https://3ds.bank.com/auth' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN'"

kai (payments): That console error is the smoking gun — the bank is returning an HTML page that can't be framed. Hosted pay link should redirect the whole window to the bank challenge, not frame it. Could be our embed option used a frame fallback.

jordan (support): Repro steps for engineering/ops: 
1) Open invoice pay link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoice/INV-2025-091/pay (do not paste card data in public logs)
2) Watch network/activity for PaymentIntent creation -> PI id: pi_1JqXy2...
3) Observe next_action: `redirect_to_url` vs `use_stripe_sdk`. If redirect_to_url, the browser should navigate. If page attempts to load in an iframe and bank sets X-Frame-Options, challenge will fail.

kai (payments): Suggested fix paths: 
- Short term: send the customer a 'pay via phone' instruction or ask for a different card that doesn't trigger SCA. 
- Preferred: use hosted redirect flow (checkout) that performs a full-window redirect instead of embedding in a frame.
- If customer can't complete SCA, finance can accept bank transfer / wire and mark invoice paid.

jordan (support): I'm escalating to #finance-escalations to approve manual settlement options. @finance-escalations can you confirm wire instructions / manual mark-pay process?

finance-escalations: FYI, we can accept wire or ACH for this customer. If they provide bank remittance and reference INV-2025-091, finance can clear the invoice and note the payment method. For card retry, we should avoid iframe embed; ask customer to open the hosted link directly.

payments-bot: note logged -> escalation_id esc_2026_00012 created, linked to INV-2025-091

lina (customer): Customer will try opening the pay link directly on a laptop browser and also prefers to get the wire details if that still fails.

jordan (support): Great. I've added the logs, the PI id, and the console snippet to the ticket. Next steps: 
- Lina: try hosted link in a different browser and confirm result. If still fails, we'll provide wire instructions and finance will clear the invoice. 
- Kai/Payments: investigate whether our embed fallback could attempt a frame; if so, we should force full redirect for hosted payments.

kail (payments): noted, I'll follow up in this thread with any config changes.

jordan (support): Closing loop when payment confirmed. If you need a manual pay link or wire details sooner, ping me and I'll share the finance contact. :thumbsup:
